table.retrieve:
SELECT  SL.saleinvcode,
	Custcode=C.Custcode,
	AliasName=A.AliasName,
	Customer=A.Name,
	Net=Round(
		SUM((SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
		(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)) + 
		SL.misccharges + SL.salestax - SL.flatdisc, 0)+
		Round(SUM( (SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty) * SD.unitsalestax) + 
		SUM(ROUND( (SD.looseqty * (SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc)) * SD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
		ROUND( (SUM((SD.looseqty * 
			(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)) -
			SL.flatdisc) * (SL.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0),
	UserCode=SL.salesmancode,
	UserName=CASE WHEN :ar_usergrouping='Y' THEN U.UserName ELSE '' END,
	Balance=CASE WHEN :ar_printbalance = 'Y' THEN MAX(Isnull(B.Balance, 0)) ELSE 0 END,
	Address=C.Address1

FROM    saleledger SL,	 
	saledetail SD,
	(SELECT  Acccode,
		Balance=Sum(debit-credit)
	From VirtualGL
	Where Acccode IN (select custcode from customer)
	Group By Acccode
	UNION
	SELECT  Acccode,
		Balance=0
	From Accounts
	Where Acccode NOT IN (select distinct acccode from virtualgl)) B,
	Customer C,
	Accounts A,
	Users U


WHERE   (SL.Posted = Case :ar_postedunposted 
						 WHEN 'B' THEN 'Y'
						 WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Y'
			  			 WHEN 'N' THEN 'N'
			  			 ELSE 'Z'
						 END OR
		SL.Posted = Case :ar_postedunposted 
						 WHEN 'B' THEN 'N'
						 WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Y'
			  			 WHEN 'N' THEN 'N'
			  			 ELSE 'Z'
						 END) AND
		SL.SaleInvCode Between :ar_SinvCode AND :ar_LinvCode AND
		SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvcode AND
		SL.SalesManCode IN (:ar_UserCode) AND
		SL.SalesManCode = U.UserCODE AND
		SL.Custcode = C.Custcode AND
		C.CustCode=A.Acccode AND
		A.Acccode = B.Acccode

GROUP BY SL.saleinvcode,
	 C.CustCode,
	 A.Name,
	 SL.date,
	 SL.discperc,
	 SL.misccharges,
	 SL.salestax,
	 SL.flatdisc,
	 SL.invgstperc1,
	 SL.salesmancode,
	 U.UserName,
	 C.Address1,
	 A.AliasName
Order BY 
	 U.UserName,
	 SL.SaleInvCode,
	 A.AliasName,
	 Customer

objects.name: compute_9
objects.expression: case( ar_postedunposted when 'B' then 'Both Posted AND Un-Posted' when 'Y' then 'Posted Only' when 'N' then 'Unposted Only' ELSE 'Neigther Posted Nor Un-Posted')
